thread:
Marta: quick idea 2: add an "Effective preview" inline to Roles that shows per-route allow/deny and the applied quota (useful for oncall & PMs when debugging 403 vs 429).

Ben: sounds helpful. two implementation paths: compute client-side by merging role/bindings/state, or a backend compute endpoint that returns the resolved view. client is fast to iterate but risky for consistency.

Ashok: we should centralize it server-side. the API is the source of truth for enforcement; shipping fragile RBAC logic to multiple console clients will cause bugs. propose backend endpoint + short-lived caching.

Kai: UX: display two columns per route: Permission: (Allowed / Denied) + origin (group X, tenant preset), and Quota: value + origin. show a compact diff chip when role-level vs route-level differ. tooltip: "Why allowed: inherited from group engineering via binding E-ops".

Marta: also need a privacy gate: non-admins must not see raw internal IDs during rollout. expose friendly names and only reveal canonical IDs to auditors.

Ben: that means the endpoint must respect viewer context and redact fields based on audit scopes. telemetry-wise, emit an event rbac.preview.request and include viewer_role and target_role_id (obfuscated) for audit.

Ashok: sketch of API: 
```
POST /internal/rbac/preview
body: { "role_id": "R-23", "routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeds"], "viewer": "me" }
response: [{"route":"/v1/generate","allowed":"true","allowed_by":"team-llm","quota":"50r/min","quota_source":"tenant-preset"}, ...]
```
Server will memoize per request and cache per role+route for 60s; invalidate on role/binding changes. audit log when viewer != owner.

Kai: edge: when quota is logically unlimited but infra-level shard caps exist, show both: Logical: unlimited (source X) ; Shard cap: 200r/min (source infra-shard). Use a clear label "effective cap" which is min(logical, shard).

Marta: perf: console calls this for role list (N routes). cannot spin 100 requests. need a batch RPC and a condensed response suitable for list rendering.

Ashok: agree. implement a batch endpoint that accepts multiple routes and returns a compact per-route summary. within request, dedupe computation per (role,route) and reuse cached entries.

Ben: add metrics: rbac.preview.requests, rbac.preview.cache_hits, rbac.preview.cache_misses. ops asked for a percent-cached gauge to track cache effectiveness.

Kai: accessibility: diff chip should expose aria-labels like "Quota overridden: 100 requests per minute from tenant preset" and be keyboard focusable.

Marta: product wants an enterprise toggle "Show system sources" off by default; enterprise admins can opt-in to reveal system-level bindings and IDs. include in mockups.

Ben: I'll draft the API proto and security gating. Ashok, can you size the backend work? include telemetry, audit hooks, cache infra.

Ashok: rough size: 3 dev days to implement endpoint + caching + unit tests, 1 day infra to wire metrics/audit sink; add QA time for redaction rules.

Marta: will write a short PRD and attach console mocks (list view with diff chips + expanded per-route detail).

console-bot: PRD created: https://go/redwood/prd/effective-preview-roles 5 (linked).
